## Checklist

- [ ] The commits follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:` …).
- [ ] New behaviour has tests; a fixed defect has a test that failed before.
- [ ] Tests and fixtures use synthetic data only: no real names, addresses, identifiers, credentials or production logs.
- [ ] No runtime dependency was added.
- [ ] Public API changes are in `CHANGELOG.md` under `Unreleased`.
